text:
incident-bot: Paging — P1: elevated 502/timeout for hydrangea-enterprise (VPC) in us-east1. Multiple customer sessions failing. Auto-escalation to SRE and Eng.
oncall-ryan: I'm on it, joining now.
sre-maya: seeing spike in 50x errors from dedicated pool gpud-2-east1, qps steady but tail latencies jump. Lots of KV cache misses.
eng-nikhil: putting up warm nodes in us-west2: hydra-warm-01..03, I estimate 3-5m to be ready.
se-anna: CSM notified, customer reports ~40% of requests erroring; some users see corrupted responses. They're in a regulated VPC so we must avoid touching their data plane.
ops-lee: recommend DNS weighted shift to us-west2 VIP after warm ready. Set TTL=30 temporarily.
sre-maya: quick logs: 
```
ERROR 502 gateway: upstream connection reset
pod: gpud-2-7f9d - 87% cpu, 12% mem
latency p99: 3.1s -> 12.4s
```
eng-nikhil: proposed plan: 1) spin warm 2) validate health 3) set DNS weight 10% canary 4) monitor 5) ramp to 100% if green.
oncall-ryan: I'll own rollout steps and schedule handoff to eng-oncall-leo in 30m.
support-jordan: I created a customer incident note and asked for their tolerance for a brief DNS failover — they prefer a controlled cutover window.
se-anna: customer asked for IP-level cutover if possible; we can't modify their VPC routes — DNS only.
eng-nikhil: healthcheck snippet I'll use:
```sh
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://vip.hydrangea.example/health || echo fail
```
ops-lee: pre-change checklist:
- TTL=30 applied to VIP (do now)
- Warm nodes healthy (HTTP 200 on /health)
- Autoscaler paused for target pool
- Routing policy set to weighted

oncall-ryan: applying TTL change now.
incident-bot: [audit] DNS record vip.hydrangea.example TTL updated from 300 -> 30 by ops-lee at 11:03Z.
eng-nikhil: warm nodes reporting 200 on /health, KV warm-up in progress (~60%).
oncall-ryan: starting 10% weight to us-west2. watching errors and latency.
eng-nikhil: metrics look good at 10% for 5m, no error increase. ramping to 50%.
sre-maya: p50/p95 stable, p99 dropping to 2.1s on canary. No increase in errors.
support-jordan: telling customer we started 10% at 11:10Z, will provide next update at 11:20Z.
oncall-ryan: 50% -> 100% now, finalizing.
eng-oncall-leo: taking over incident at 11:20Z for monitoring and postmortem.
incident-bot: Incident status: mitigation in place, traffic shifted to us-west2 warm capacity, customer impact reduced to <1% errors. Postmortem owner assigned: eng-nikhil. :white_check_mark:
ops-lee: reverting TTL to 300 in 30m if stable.
sre-maya: capturing logs to support ticket and saving KV cache dump for analysis.
support-jordan: flagged for priority follow-up with CSM tomorrow.
eng-nikhil: notes for postmortem: investigate kernel-level networking reset on gpud-2 nodes, review KV cache warm strategy, evaluate autoscaler behavior under steady qps.
oncall-ryan: thanks all — closing operational loop, handing to eng-oncall-leo. :thumbsup:
